item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Renews Threats Against Iranian Oil and Energy Facilities
item.summary: President Trump claimed progress in talks to end the war but warned that lacking a deal he would order intense attacks on Iranian infrastructure targets. Oil and stock markets wavered on the news.

item.title: Israel Passes Law to Hang Palestinians Convicted of Deadly Attacks
item.summary: Experts say the law was written in such a way as to ensure that it was unlikely to ever apply to Jewish extremists who commit similar crimes.

item.title: Myanmar’s Military Leader Moves One Step Closer to Becoming President
item.summary: Senior Gen. Min Aung Hlaing stepped down as commander in chief and is expected to be installed as the next civilian leader of the country by its rubber-stamp Parliament.

item.title: Australian Police Kill Man Suspected of Slaying 2 Officers
item.summary: The fugitive, who was trained in surviving in the bush, had been on the run since a deadly confrontation last August with officers who had come to execute a search warrant.

item.title: A New U.S. Missile Hit a Sports Hall in Iran. Here’s What We Know About It.
item.summary: Barely out of prototype testing, the Precision Strike Missile is shrouded in secrecy — including which Persian Gulf countries the Army is launching them from.

item.title: Palm Sunday Attack in Nigeria Leaves at Least 12 Dead
item.summary: No one has claimed responsibility for the killings in the mostly Christian city of Jos, and the police have yet to arrest the gunmen.

item.title: Can the ‘Dubai Dream’ Survive the War? Residents Say Life Goes On.
item.summary: The Emirates’ largest city pitched itself to foreign workers and tourists as a sun-soaked safe haven in a volatile region. War has challenged that image.

item.title: Iran’s Fractured Leadership Is Struggling to Coordinate, Officials Say
item.summary: As leaders are killed and replaced, Iranian negotiators may not know what their government is willing to concede in any negotiations.

item.title: Trump Zigzags on Iran, Claiming ‘Great Progress’ but Making Threats
item.summary: President Trump threatened to hit vital infrastructure in Iran if the Strait of Hormuz was not reopened, but he also said that “regime change” had already been achieved.

item.title: Israel Pulls Battalion From West Bank After Soldier Talks of ‘Revenge’
item.summary: While detaining a CNN crew, a soldier said that Israeli troops were motivated by “revenge” against Palestinians and that all of the West Bank was “for the Jews.”
